'''Zal Dinnes''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] [[Rebel pilot|pilot]] who served in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. She flew a [[T-65B X-wing starfighter]] under the [[callsign]] [[Red Eight]] in [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Red Squadron]] at the [[Battle of Scarif]] and [[Death|died]] at the [[Battle of Yavin]].

==Biography==
===Early life===
[[File:TierfonYellowAces.svg|thumb|left|150px|Dinnes served in the Tierfon Yellow Aces]]
[[Homeworld|Hailing]] from [[Tierfon]],<ref name="USWNE" /> Zal Dinnes served as a [[Rebel pilot|pilot]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]]. Under the rank of [[lieutenant]], Dinnes was assigned to the [[Tierfon Launch Base]] as a member of the [[Tierfon Yellow Aces]] [[starfighter]] [[squadron]]. When encroaching [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] patrols forced the rebels to scuttle the base on Tierfon, and the Yellow Aces disbanded. Dinnes, along with [[Jek Tono Porkins]] and two other pilots were transferred to the [[Great Temple|Rebel base]] on [[Yavin 4]], where Dinnes and Porkins were assigned to [[Commander]] [[Garven Dreis]]' [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Red Squadron]], where Dinnes obtained the [[callsign]] [[Red Eight]].<ref name="Visual Guide" />

===Operation Fracture===
[[File:Rebel-pilots-Dinnes-Surrel-ROUVG.png|thumb|right|250px|Dinnes (right) among the many pilots on constant flight readiness at Yavin]]
During [[Operation Fracture]], [[Admiral]] [[Raddus]] sent a readiness report to [[Mon Mothma]], which stated the Alliance [[starfighter]] [[squadron]]s were prepared to support [[Captain]] [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor's]] mission. While he stated the most likely scenario was for an extraction team featuring [[UT-60D U-wing starfighter/support craft]] from [[Blue Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Blue Squadron]], he also confirmed that Red Squadron's twelve [[X-wing starfighter|X-wings]] and [[pilot]]s were flight ready, along with [[Green Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Green Squadron]]. In case reinforcements were needed, allied rebel movements, including Dinnes' previous unit, the Tierfon Yellow Aces, were on alert and stood ready to supply starfighters and pilots from those squadrons.<ref name="Rebel Dossier">''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: Rebel Dossier]]''</ref>

===Scarif===
{{Quote|Red and Gold Squadrons, attack formations. Defend the fleet.|Admiral Raddus giving Red and Gold Squadrons their orders|<ref name="Rogue One">''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref>|audio=Raddus-RedAndGold-RO.flac}}
[[File:Rebel_Fleet_above_Scarif.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Red Squadron and the fleet at Scarif]]
In [[1 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> the Rebel Alliance sent [[Rebel Alliance Navy|reinforcements]] to support [[Rogue One]] at the [[Battle of Scarif]], after they had launched on a mission, defiant against the decision of the [[Alliance High Command|Alliance Council]], to steal plans to the Empire's new secret superweapon, the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]]. Zal Dinnes and the rest of Red Squadron, under the command of Garven Dreis, were tasked with defending the fleet over [[Scarif]]. The squadron's X-wings engaged [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter]]s above the [[planet]] and attacked the [[Shield Gate]].<ref name="Rogue One" />

The fleet managed to destroy the two [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyers]] protecting it, which led to the destruction of the Shield Gate and the collapse of the planetary shield. This allowed the stolen plans to be transmitted to the fleet's flagship, the ''[[Profundity]]'', just as the Death Star arrived in the system and destroyed the [[Citadel Tower]] and those still on the surface. Darth Vader had arrived too, aboard the [[Star Destroyer]], ''[[Devastator]]'', preventing some of the Alliance forces from escaping, but was unsuccessful in stopping the plans to get away aboard the [[CR90 corvette]] ''[[Tantive IV]]'' with [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]].<ref name="Rogue One" /> Dinnes and few other pilots managed to escape, and showed pride on their faces after the battle.<ref name="Duty">{{StoryCite|story=Duty Roster|book=From a Certain Point of View}}</ref>

===Yavin===
{{Quote|Third flight, Zal, you'll fly lead as Red Eight. Wings are Naytaan and Porkins, as Red Nine and Red Six.|Garven Dreis, briefs Red Squadron prior to the Battle of Yavin|<ref name="Date" />}}
[[File:Battle_of_Yavin.png|thumb|right|250px|Dinnes was one of thirty rebel pilots at the Battle of Yavin]]
Shortly after,<ref name="Date" /> the Empire's Death Star arrived in the [[Yavin system]] to destroy the rebel base.<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref> Dinnes was in the ready room with the rest of Red Squadron, when its commander, Dreis, ran through the duty roster for the [[Battle of Yavin]], in which he assigned the pilots to their flights and callsigns. Dinnes was assigned as leader of [[Third flight]] for the assault, with [[Red Nine]] [[Nozzo Naytaan]] and [[Red Six]] Jek Porkins as her [[wingmate]]s.<ref name="Duty" />

Thirty Alliance [[starfighter]]s from Red,<ref name="ANH" /> Green,<ref name="Sparks">{{StoryCite|story=Sparks (short story)|book=From a Certain Point of View}}</ref> and [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Gold Squadrons]] were launched in the assault on the battle station on the far side of [[Yavin Prime]],<ref name="ANH" /> however Dinnes was [[Death|killed]] in her [[T-65B X-wing starfighter]] along with the rest of her flight. Following the successful destruction of the Death Star, [[Luke Skywalker]] and [[Wedge Antilles]] were the only suvivors from Red Squadron, as well as one [[Evaan Verlaine|other pilot]] from Gold Squadron.<ref name="Duty" />

===Legacy===
{{Quote|To Dreis, Branon, Porkins, Rue, Dinnes, Naytaan, Nett, Surrel, Naeco,…And Biggs.|Skywalker, honoring Dinnes and Red Squadron's actions at the Battle of Yavin|<ref name="Star Wars 45">[[Star Wars (2015) 45|''Star Wars'' (2015) 45]]</ref>}}
In [[1 ABY]],<ref name="1ABY">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the [[Battle of Mako-Ta]] to [[1 ABY]].</ref> Skywalker and fellow rebel pilots Antilles, [[Zev Senesca]], [[Derek Klivian]], [[Han Solo]], and [[Chewbacca]], raised a toast at [[Mess Hall IV]] in the [[Mako-Ta Space Docks]] to honor the deceased members of Red Squadron, including Dinnes.<ref name="Star Wars 45" />

==Personality and traits==
Zal Dinnes was a human female with [[Color|blonde]] [[hair]], hazel [[eye]]s and light skin.<ref name="Visual Guide" /> She was a committed enemy of the Empire and all that it represented.<ref name="SWCT Galactic Files 2018">{{Topps|set=2018 Topps Star Wars Galactic Files|cardname=RO-32 - Lt. Zal Dinnes|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/170092/cid/11644225}}</ref>

==Skills and abilities==
Before transferring to Yavin, Zal Dinnes was considered to be an ace pilot.<ref name="SWCT Women">{{SWCT|set=Topps' Women of Star Wars|cardname=Lieutenant Zal Dinnes (Red Eight)}}</ref> She had "V"s inside the yellow dots that ran along her [[Flight helmet|helmet]] that indicated enemy fighter kills. Each mark equaled 20 enemy fighters that she killed in battle.<ref name="EW Topps">{{WebCite|url=http://www.ew.com/gallery/star-wars-rogue-one-exclusive-trading-cards/2787646_clone-gallery-exclusive-rogue-one-trading-cards-two-tubes-twins|text=New 'Rogue One' Images Revealed by Topps' 'Star Wars: Card Trader' {{C|Slide 2 of 7}}|author=Anthony Breznican|date=2016-10-15|archivedate=20180726040539}}</ref>

==Equipment==
[[File:ZalDinnesHelmet-SW100Objects.png|thumb|right|200px|Dinnes' flight helmet]]
As a Rebel Alliance X-wing starfighter pilot, Zal Dinnes wore an orange [[flight suit]], with a white [[flak vest]], a [[flight harness]], a [[Diagnostech life support unit]] and dark gray [[glove]]s. Her [[K-22995 light flight helmet]] was red and white, with a yellow [[Rebel Alliance starbird|starbird]], the unit insignia of the Tierfon Yellow Aces.<ref name="Visual Guide" />

==Behind the scenes==
Zal Dinnes was portrayed by [[Zarene Dallas]] in ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'',<ref name="Dallas">{{Topps|set=2017 Topps Star Wars High Tek|cardname=Autographs #84 - Rogue One Signers - Zarene Dallas, Lt. Zal Dinnes|link=https://www.comc.com/Cards/Non-Sports/2017/Topps_Star_Wars_High_Tek_-_Autographs/84/Rogue_One_Signers_-_Zarene_Dallas_Lt_Zal_Dinnes/12919529}}</ref> but her role was not listed in the end credits.<ref name="RO credits">''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref> The character was revealed on [[October 15]], [[2016]] by [[Entertainment Weekly Books|''Entertainment Weekly'']] in an exclusive trading card from [[Star Wars: Card Trader|''Star Wars'': Card Trader]].<ref name="EW Topps" />
